rules.summary: Land-based fishers in the West Coast bioregion: combined bag limit of 2 demersal scalefish. Boat-based demersal fishing in the West Coast region is closed (boat fishing is outside this app's scope). Check DPIRD for the full list of demersal species and size limits.
